book.name: Maaroko
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Maaroko

content: Yɨɨsu arahorya ʉmʉʉtʉ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ
Urusikʉ ʉrʉndɨ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ, Yɨɨsu akasikɨra mwirwazɨrʉ rya Kapɨrinaumu, aareho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ arɨmɨɨrɨ okobhoko.
Abhafarisaayo bhaarɨ bhiitɨgirɨ Yɨɨsu, bharore arɨɨbhɨ arahorya ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ. Areemohorye bhabhone ɨnzɨra yu ukumwinatiriryaku.
Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra omorema wo okobhoko, “Nauzɨ, wiimɨɨrɨrɨ gatɨgatɨ.”
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ, nɨ‑bhwaheene kurusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ, kokora amazʉmu kisha kokora amabhɨ, kohorya kisha kwita?” Ebho bhakakira.

Yɨɨsu akabharora kʉbhʉrʉrʉ, akarumɨka mumwʉyʉ gwazɨ igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉkʉngʼu bhwi imyʉyʉ jabhʉ. Neho Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra ʉmʉʉtʉ wurya, “Gorora okobhoko kwazʉ.” Ʉmʉʉtʉ wurya akagorora okobhoko kwazɨ, rogendo rʉmwɨ kʉkahora!
Hayohayo Abhafarisaayo bharya bhakahʉrʉka igʉtʉ, bhakarumana na kʉgambana na abhasakirya bha riribhita ryʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Heroode Antipaasi.
Bhakagambana chɨmbu bharaarichɨ Yɨɨsu.
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bharamujaku Yɨɨsu
Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉka hayo, akaja kʉnyanza ya Gariraaya hamwɨmwɨ na abhɨɨga bhaazɨ. Riribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ rɨkamutuna kurwa mubhyarʉ bhya Gariraaya na Yudeya,

ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu, na Idumaaya, imwambʉkʉ wɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ cha Yorodaani na haguhɨ na zɨmbɨri za Tiiro na Sidʉʉni. Abhaatʉ bhayo bhakamujaku, kʉ kʉbha bhaarɨ bhiigwirɨ igʉrʉ wɨ ɨbhɨsɨgʉ bhɨnʉ aarɨ akʉrirɨ.
Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakonze ubhwatʉ, kʉ kʉbha riribhita rirya ryarɨ ikʉrʉ bhʉkʉngʼu, hanʉ rɨraamʉhɨgɨ asikɨrɨ mubhwatʉ.
Abharwɨrɨ bhaarɨ bharahɨgana korereke bhamukunʼyɨku, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ ahʉriryɨ bhaaru.
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ na amasambwa hanʉ bhaamʉrʉʉzɨbhu, bhaarɨ bharagwa kʉmagʉrʉ gaazɨ na kʉrɨra kwiraka ɨkʉrʉ, “Awɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu!”
Neho akagarecha amasambwa kwa bhʉhaari, gatamukumucha kʉbhaatʉ kʉbha ewe nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ.
Yɨɨsu ararobhora abhatumwa ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ
Yɨɨsu akatiira kʉkɨgʉrʉ. Akabhabhɨrɨkɨra abhaatʉ bhanʉ ɨɨndirɨ, bhakamujaku.
Akarobhora abhaatʉ ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ bhanʉ aabhabhirikiirɨ abhatumwa,
korereke bhabhɨ hamwɨmwɨ nawe, abhatʉmɨ kurwaza,
na abhahɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhwu ukuruusha amasambwa kʉbhaatʉ.
Ganʉ nego amariina ga abhaatʉ ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ bhanʉ aarʉbhwɨrɨ: Simʉʉni, wʉnʉ Yɨɨsu aamʉhɨɨrɨ iriina ɨrɨndɨ, Peetero,
Yaakobho na Yoohana abhaana bha Zebhedaayo, Yɨɨsu akabhaha iriina rya Bhowanɨrigɨ, enzobhooro yaku abhaana bhu umurumo,
Andureya, Firipʉ, Bhatoromayo, Mataayo, Tomaaso, Yaakobho umwana wa Arifaayʉ, Tadaayo, Simʉʉni Ʉmʉkananayʉ,
enzobhooro yaku ni‑mwitaniri wi icharʉ chazɨ,
na Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti, wʉnʉ iichurirɨ Yɨɨsu. Yɨɨsu nɨ‑mʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa amasambwa (Mataayo 12:22‑32; Ruuka 11:14‑23, 12:10) Akʉmara Yɨɨsu akagarʉka yɨɨka, akasikɨra munyumba.
Riribhita rya abhaatʉ rikiibhiringa harya kwikɨ, kuhika Yɨɨsu na abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakatama nʉʉrʉ kurya ibhyakurya.
Hanʉ unina na abhahiiri bhaazɨ bhiigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, bhakaja komogega, bhaarɨ bharabhuga amangʼɨɨni gatarɨ bhwaheene.
Abhiija bhi imigirʉ ja Musa, bhanʉ bhaaruurɨ mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu bhaarɨ bharabhuga, “Atiirirwɨ na Bhɨɨrizɨbhuri. Araheebha amasambwa kʉbhʉnaja bhwa Bhɨɨrizɨbhuri,
ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa amasambwa!”
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhɨrɨkɨra, akatanga kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra kobherenjo, “Shɨtaani aratʉrabhwɨ kwiruusha umwene?
Arɨɨbhɨ abhaatʉ bhʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhʉmwɨ bhariitana abheene kobheene, ʉbhʉtɨmi bhuyo bhʉragwa.
Na abhaatʉ bhi inyumba yɨmwɨ arɨɨbhɨ bharatanga kwitana abheene kobheene, ikishoko kiyo kɨtakʉrama nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu.
Arɨɨbhɨ Shɨtaani ariitana na amasambwa amakɨndichazɨ, ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwazɨ bhʉtwanɨkɨɨnɨ, bhʉratʉra kwimɨɨrɨrabhwɨ? Bhʉtakʉtʉra kwimɨɨrɨra nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu, maheene bhugwirɨ kɨmwɨ.
Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kusikɨra munyumba yʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wa amanaga, na kumuruusha ebhegero bhyazɨ, akɨɨrɨ komobhoha. Areemobhohe, hayo aratʉra kumuruusha ebhegero bhyazɨ.
“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, abhaatʉ bharabheererwa ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ bhwʉsi. Na bharabheererwa ekerege chabhʉ chʉsi.
Nawe, arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ ararega Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, atakobheererwa nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu. Wuyo arabha ni isoro ryʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwa kemerano.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨrabhu, kʉ kʉbha ebho bhaarɨ bharabhuga, “Ana risambwa.”
Abhahiiri bha Yɨɨsu bha amaheene
Neho unina Yɨɨsu na abhahiiri bhaazɨ bhakahika, bhakiimɨɨrɨra igʉtʉ wi inyumba yɨnʉ aarɨmu. Bhakatʉma ʉmʉʉtʉ abhɨrɨkɨrɨ Yɨɨsu, bhagambanɨ neewe.
Riribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ ryarɨ ryikɨɨrɨ, rimwinaarirɨ. Bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra Yɨɨsu, “Rora, onyoko na bhaumwanyu bhari igʉtʉ, bharakwenda.”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Yiiya na bhaumwɨtʉ, nɨ‑bha wɨɨwɨ?”
Akabharora abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhiikɨɨrɨ bhamwinaarirɨ, akabhuga, “Morore, bhanʉ nebho bha yiiya na bhaumwɨtʉ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akokora ubhwɨndi bhwa Mungu, wuyo newe umwɨtʉ, umusubhaati na yiiya.”

footnotes.text: Abhasakirya bha riribhita ryʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Heroode Antipaasi bhaarɨ riribhita rya Abhayaahudi rɨnʉ ryisiriiryɨ ʉbhʉkangati bhwa Abharuumi mucharʉ chabhʉ. Ebho na Abhafarisaayo bhataasɨɨgirɨ, nawe bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bharʉʉbhaha komenyekana kwa Yɨɨsu mucharʉ chʉsi, neho bhakatanga kwisiriranʼya komohya ɨnzɨra yu ukwita Yɨɨsu. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana Heroode Antipaasi muKiniibhasa.

Simʉʉni Ʉmʉkananayʉ aarɨ na amariina abhɨrɨ, ɨrɨmwɨ ryi Ikigiriki, Simʉʉni Ʉmʉzɨrʉʉti ɨrɨndɨ ryɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi, Simʉʉni Ʉmʉkananayʉ. Gʉʉsi gane enzobhooro yɨmwɨ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwitanɨra ubhwiyagaaruri bhwɨ ɨɨsɨ yaazɨ.
